read.thesis: NextEra Q1 adjusted EPS $1.09 (+10% y/y) with NEER backlog ~33 GW after a record 4 GW origination; guidance unchanged at $3.92–4.02, targeting high end, and FPL capex of $12–13B reaffirmed.

capex.quote: full-year capital investments are expected to be between $12 billion and $13 billion

triggers.label: Record 4 GW renewables and storage origination
triggers.quote: adding 4 gigawatts to its backlog, including another strong quarter of battery storage origination at 1.3 gigawatts

triggers.label: 9.5 GW gas for large load (Japan deal)
triggers.quote: the U.S. Department of Commerce selected NextEra Energy Resources to build 9.5 GW of new gas-fired generation to serve large load in Texas and Pennsylvania
triggers.highlight: build 9.5 GW of new gas-fired generation

triggers.label: EPS guide held, targeting high end
triggers.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02 and is targeting the high end of that range
triggers.highlight: targeting the high end of that range

guidance.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02 and is targeting the high end of that range
we expect to grow adjusted earnings per share at a compound annual growth rate of 8%+ through 2032
full-year capital investments are expected to be between $12 billion and $13 billion
continues to expect to grow its dividends per share at a roughly 10% rate per year through 2026
